note: Dane fikcyjne (hackathon): bez prawdziwych osób, znaków wywoławczych i numerów seryjnych.
_doc: One unit per roster id (rescue/app/CONTRACT.md 'Zasoby i dziennik' section 5). Crew = role + fictional label. byHome = per scenario that defines the id: name, base, operator, crew of THAT region's unit (a shared id is a different unit per region; with ?sc= show byHome[sc], top-level = the first scenario's variant). Health parameters per kind: params.json (sources in docs/rescue-locator/zasoby.md).
